name: How can I prevent mold from growing around my windows?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold from growing around my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold around windows involves controlling moisture and humidity. Regularly wipe away condensation from window sills and frames. Improve ventilation by opening windows periodically or using exhaust fans, especially in high-humidity areas. Ensure your window seals are intact and address any leaks promptly. You can also use dehumidifiers in humid climates and keep your indoor humidity levels between 30% and 50%. Proper insulation can also reduce condensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by wiping condensation, improving ventilation, sealing leaks, using dehumidifiers, and maintaining indoor humidity between 30% and 50%.
